verdict.rationale: The IRS documents real machine channels for some UI functions: MeF accepts XML returns system-to-system, and IRIS has an Application-to-Application intake alongside its portal. Both are credentialed, gated by provider enrollment, fingerprinting and Transmitter Control Codes. Much of the UI surface has no documented API: the EIN online assistant, Online Account and signed mobile-friendly forms (behind the ID.me biometric wall), and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: API coverage of EIN application, Online Account, transcripts, payments and signed forms such as Form 15620, a public documented API spec, and self-serve API access.
